title: Aureline M5 shipping-line drift report
description: Canonical per-domain drift report minted by the bundle-refresh-audit and shipping-line-drift-report lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Records the shipping-line drift a bundle-currentness audit found against a claimed launch bundle, imported-user handoff bundle, or org-approved bundle: stale-bundle drift (the bundle went stale on the shipping line), non-reversible-bundle drift (the bundle can no longer be reversed / rolled back), or unsupported-bundle drift (the bundle drifted into an unsupported state or is missing artifacts). Names the drift scope, binds the resolved line identity, the affected-claim reference, the target-train reference, and the active drift reason so start-center, migration/help, release/support, and admin/public-proof surfaces can distinguish current, reversible bundles from stale, non-reversible, or unsupported ones still narrowing supported-line onboarding / migration / support claims rather than reading a launch bundle as silently supportable. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's bundle-drift posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
